use_case.title: technektar.dev — landing page
use_case.target_audience: Hiring managers and senior AI engineers evaluating Sharath's context-engineering work
use_case.notes: Hosted custom domain (not a github.io page). 'web' substrate covers either git-backed PRs or paste-ready HTML/Markdown depending on whether we have repo access on first inspection. Iteration cadence: ~weekly.

recommendation.diff_summary: Apply atomic-snippet-density via json_ld_faqpage on https://www.technektar.dev (web substrate, voice=clinical-and-cited).
recommendation.rationale: FAQPage JSON-LD gives engines a citation-shaped target with explicit Question/Answer pairs and source attribution.

recommendation.diff_summary: Apply semantic-anchor-stability via h2_h3_canonical_anchors on https://www.technektar.dev (web substrate, voice=clinical-and-cited).
recommendation.rationale: Stable canonical heading anchors let engines re-cite the same fragment across iterations without re-resolving.

recommendation.diff_summary: Apply q-shaped-subhead-lattice via h2_subhead_questions on https://www.technektar.dev (web substrate, voice=clinical-and-cited).
recommendation.rationale: Subheads phrased as the visitor's question raise semantic similarity against engine-side prompt embeddings.

recommendation.diff_summary: Apply cross-engine-intermediary via outbound_authority_link_block on https://www.technektar.dev (web substrate, voice=clinical-and-cited).
recommendation.rationale: An outbound authority link block gives Perplexity-class engines a citation chain they will reuse on subsequent answers.

recommendation.diff_summary: Apply inverted-retrieval-target via answer_first_lede on https://www.technektar.dev (web substrate, voice=clinical-and-cited).
recommendation.rationale: Putting the citable answer in the first 200 chars inverts the page so retrievers extract it before the supporting prose.
